actions.description:
Trigger Jewel is either killed or knocked Unconscious

Effect Pavetta flies into a rage. She gains 20 temporary Hit Points, gains a +4 circumstance bonus on attack rolls, and deals 4d6 additional damage with melee weapons. In addition, she becomes Confused. This rage persists for 1 minute or until she ceases to be confused, after which she becomes Fatigued.

Effect: Rage
actions.name: Vengeful Rage
actions.trigger: Jewel is either killed or knocked Unconscious

actions.description: With a command to Jewel, Pavetta releases her to serve as a minion. She must concentrate to sustain this ability, during which she continues to shout commands to the little dog.
actions.name: Release Jewel

actions.description: Pavetta attempts a single Intimidation check to Demoralize and applies the result to every opponent within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet}. Additionally, she automatically alerts any allies within 100 feet that are able to hear her to her need for assistance. The baroness can't Scream for 1 round.
actions.name: Baroness's Scream

actions.description:
Requirement Pavetta is affected by Vengeful Rage.

Effect Pavetta makes up to five melee Strikes with her dagger, each against a different target. These attacks count toward her multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after she makes all of her attacks.
actions.name: Stabbing Fit
